canonical_type_policy.rule: canonical entity_type is reviewed target semantics and is not inferred automatically from SIMBAD otype

coordinate_policy.definition: Reviewed ICRS J2000 catalogue anchor/reference position of the resolved SIMBAD provider record; not an asserted geometric target centre.

m102_policy.alternative: NASA HEASARC notes its electronic catalogue contains 109 entries because M102 is generally considered spurious/actually M101.
m102_policy.ambiguity: Historical Messier 102 identity is disputed; some catalogues treat M102 as spurious or duplicative of M101.
m102_policy.operational_convention: Modern 110-object observing convention; Messier 102 operationally represented by the Spindle Galaxy/NGC 5866 identity.
m102_policy.simbad_evidence: M 102 has SIMBAD main identity M 102, type SyG, with NGC 5866 among accepted identifiers.

special_cases.M102: SIMBAD SyG; represented as galaxy under the modern 110-object operational convention while retaining historical ambiguity.
special_cases.M16: NASA Eagle Nebula collective observing target; scope compound and explicitly encompasses IC 4703 plus NGC 6611 without creating a component graph or centroid.
special_cases.M17: NASA Omega/Swan Nebula observing target; SIMBAD OpC and NGC 6618 identity remain provider evidence.
special_cases.M20: NASA Trifid Nebula observing target; SIMBAD OpC and NGC 6514 identity remain provider evidence.
special_cases.M24: SIMBAD As* and NASA Star Cloud; represented as sky_region.
special_cases.M40: SIMBAD unknown object type; represented as system under the existing explicit mapping.
special_cases.M73: SIMBAD err / Not an Object; represented as sky_region under the existing explicit mapping.
special_cases.M8: NASA Lagoon Nebula observing target; SIMBAD OpC remains provider evidence; associated NGC 6530 does not redefine the Messier entity.

vizier_verification: Identity verification only; no VizieR rows are redistributed in this repository. NGC/IC/common-name relationships were reviewed where applicable and historical VizieR coordinates do not override selected SIMBAD positions.
